instruction: How to set custom log format in Caddyfile
output: echo 'example.com { log { output file /var/log/caddy/access.log format json } reverse_proxy localhost:8080 }' >> /etc/caddy/Caddyfile

instruction: How to add rate limiting in Caddyfile
